ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 80% high-intensity (white) pixels in central lobe regions relative to 20% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated at margins and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white zones occupy the interior of both lobes; continuous low-intensity black perimeter along the trailing edge and leading margins; a vertical low-intensity band bisects the fluke at the median notch; several small low-intensity focal spots are visible in the lower-mid region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 48 degrees; depth extends significantly toward the anterior leading edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected along the entire trailing edge; primary amplitude peaks are located at the distal tips; secondary low-amplitude valleys distributed evenly across both lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong upward convexity; trajectories sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips with an increasing positive gradient.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized low-intensity pixel clusters detected at the far distal tips of both lobes; a specific cluster of high-contrast dark pixels is visible at the left tip's trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel dark linear streaks (rake marks) detected on the high-intensity surface of the left lobe, extending from the trailing edge toward the center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular indentation or 'chip' on the extreme left distal tip; visible jagged texture on the right distal tip suggests historical physical trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: The pigmentation pattern exhibits a 'framed' appearance where the black trailing edge margin is unusually uniform in width across the span of both lobes.
